title: Filtered derived Hom, truncations and the graded obstruction complex
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives (every object embeds into an object $I$ for which $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(-,I)$ is exact), with localizations and Hom groups taken in a common larger universe. Write $DF^b(\mathcal A)$ for the localization of bounded cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] equipped with finite decreasing filtrations by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration, def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], at maps which are quasi-isomorphisms on every graded complex. Write $\omega$ for forgetting the filtration and $\operatorname{gr}^aP=F^aP/F^{a+1}P$. Filtration bounds refer to filtration indices, independently of cochain degrees. The same notation with $+$ permits bounded-below complexes, still with finite filtrations.

For every integer $r$, the filtration truncations $t_{\ge r}P=F^rP$ and $t_{<r}P=P/F^rP$, with their induced filtrations, descend to exact functors on these localizations and give natural distinguished triangles
$$t_{\ge r}P\longrightarrow P\longrightarrow t_{<r}P\longrightarrow(t_{\ge r}P)[1].$$
The first map is the inclusion and the second is the quotient before localization. The triangle is uniquely determined, up to unique isomorphism inducing the identity on $P$, among distinguished triangles $L\to P\to R\to L[1]$ for which $\operatorname{gr}^aL=0$ for $a<r$ and $\operatorname{gr}^aR=0$ for $a\ge r$. These triangles are functorial for every morphism in the filtered derived category; after applying $\omega$ they induce the corresponding underlying triangles and their subobject and quotient maps.

There is a filtered derived global Hom bifunctor $H=R\operatorname{Hom}_F(P,Q)$, for $P,Q\in DF^b(\mathcal A)$, with values in $DF^+(\mathbf{Ab})$, such that naturally
$$\omega H\simeq R\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(\omega P,\omega Q),\qquad
\operatorname{gr}^rH\simeq\bigoplus_a R\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(\operatorname{gr}^aP,\operatorname{gr}^{a+r}Q).$$
Here ordinary global derived Hom is the derived Hom complex of abelian groups, whose $q$-th cohomology is $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(\omega P,\omega Q[q])$ (and likewise for its graded arguments). The sum is finite. Moreover
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{DF(\mathcal A)}(P,Q)\simeq H^0(\omega t_{\ge0}H).$$
The forgetful map to $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(\omega P,\omega Q)$ is $H^0$ of the inclusion $\omega t_{\ge0}H\to\omega H$. Under the displayed graded comparison, the components of the projection of a filtered morphism to $H^0(\operatorname{gr}^0H)$ are its morphisms $\operatorname{gr}^aP\to\operatorname{gr}^aQ$.
